description: An `@Injectable` class that owns application state in signals and exposes methods to change it.
Returns a read-only `Signal` view of a `WritableSignal`. Consumers can read it but cannot call `set` or `update`.
A memoized, read-only signal derived from other signals. Recomputes lazily when a dependency changes.
Producing a new array/object instead of mutating the existing one, so `Object.is` detects the change.
Registers the service in the root injector: one shared instance for the whole application.
